events.title: U.S. Jobless Claims Unexpectedly Edge Down To 197,000
events.description: A day ahead of the release of its more closely watched monthly jobs report, the Labor Department released a report on Thursday showing first-time claims for U.S. unemployment benefits unexpectedly edged slightly lower in the week ended September 26th. The Labor Department said initial jobless claims slipped to 197,000, a decrease of 1,000 from the previous week's revised level of 198,000.

events.title: Accenture Shares Climb On Strong Q4, Positive Outlook, $9.5 Bln Return Plan
events.description: Shares of Accenture plc were climbing around 18 percent in pre-market activity on the NYSE after the Irish professional services company reported Thursday strong growth in fourth-quarter earnings, revenues and bookings, with improved performance in all industry groups and regions. Further, the firm issued positive outlook for first quarter and fiscal 2027.

events.title: Bond Yields, Oil Prices Drive European Stocks To Multi-Month Low
events.description: European equities declined sharply Thursday amid weak UK housing data and softer French manufacturing reports. Despite easing US inflation concerns, investors remained reluctant to add stock positions. Oil prices climbed on Middle East tensions, with Brent crude reaching $100.79 per barrel.

events.title: U.S. Weekly Jobless Claims Unexpectedly Edge Down To 197,000
events.description: A day ahead of the release of its more closely watched monthly jobs report, the Labor Department released a report on Thursday showing first-time claims for U.S. unemployment benefits unexpectedly edged slightly lower in the week ended September 26th.

events.title: Materials, Energy Stocks May Climb Higher On Firm Commodity Prices
events.description: Bay Street is likely to open on a positive note on Thursday, tracking higher crude oil and precious metals prices. Still, inflation and interest rate concerns and higher bond yields could weigh on sentiment and limit market's upside.

events.title: Sensex, Nifty50 Extend Losses To 4th Session
events.description: India's key equity indices Sensex and Nifty50 declined for a fourth consecutive session Thursday, driven by rising oil prices, elevated bond yields, and foreign institutional investor selling ahead of a long weekend. Sensex fell 0.79% while Nifty50 dropped 0.88%.

events.title: Mixed Mood In Asian Markets
events.description: Mixed sentiment prevailed in Asian stock markets on Thursday as markets assessed the inflationary situation, the Middle East crisis, the outlook for the technology sector and the movements in bond yields. Sentiment was supported by upbeat results released by U.S. memory chip maker Micron a day earlier.

events.title: FTSE 100 Tumbles On Widespread Selling
events.description:
U.K. stocks tumbled Thursday morning, pushing the benchmark FTSE 100 down to its lowest level since June, as higher oil prices triggered inflation concerns and raised the prospects of monetary tightening by several central banks. 

Data showing a sharp slowdown in house-price growth in UK hurt as well. Bank stocks were among the major losers.

events.title: CAC 40 Slides To Lowest Level Since March As Oil, Bond Yields Rise
events.description:
France's equity benchmark CAC 40 tumbled to its lowest level since March on Thursday as stocks shed ground amid rising concerns about inflation and interest rates as oil prices climbed higher and bond yields remained elevated due to geopolitical tensions.

With no progress seen in resolving the Middle East issue, oil prices rose sharply with Brent crude futures surging to $100.79 a barrel.

events.title: Eurozone Manufacturing Activity Gathers Momentum
events.description: The euro area manufacturing activity strengthened in September as production and new orders grew at their sharpest rates since early 2022, final survey results from S&P Global showed Thursday. The final manufacturing Purchasing Managers' Index rose to 52.9 in September from 52.7 in the previous month.

events.title: DAX Hits 9-Week Low As Oil Prices, Bond Yields Surge
events.description: Germany's DAX benchmark fell to a near 9-week low Thursday, declining 0.65% amid inflation concerns, rising oil prices, and elevated bond yields. Brent crude climbed nearly 3% to $100.79 a barrel as geopolitical tensions persist.

events.title: Swiss Franc Rebounds Amid Risk-off Mood
events.description: The Swiss franc rebounded from recent lows against other major currencies in the European session on Thursday, as investor sentiment in European stock markets remained weak amidst a hardening in global bond yields.

events.title: Swiss Franc Rises Against Majors
events.description: The Swiss franc strengthened against other major currencies in the European session on Thursday.
